headline.formula: weighted mean over categories and systems of (verified + 0.5 x present) / checks

test_log.commit_source: inferred: newest commit of the audited branch before the log was written

aspects.label: Model or texture
aspects.rule: blockstates/<id>.json or textures/block/<id>.png in the client assets, and the registry loads the block from blocks.json

aspects.label: States and placement
aspects.rule: applies to blocks with properties; present if McBlockPlacement.cpp names the block, or every property name is named in placement or block-behaviour code

aspects.label: Behaviour
aspects.rule: applies to blocks with a non-shape property (age, power, lit, open...) or a block entity; present if block-behaviour code (McSim, McWorld, block use/break, containers) names the block, a tag it is in, or its id parts

aspects.label: Drops
aspects.rule: applies when loot_table/blocks/<id>.json exists; present if the block-break code reads block loot tables (and the DataCoverage test did not reject the table)

aspects.label: Sounds
aspects.rule: the port's block sound rules (McSound.cpp) pick a group; absent when they fall back to stone while the sound registry has a block.<part>.* group matching the id

aspects.label: Model
aspects.rule: items/<id>.json or textures/item/<id>.png in the client assets, and the registry loads the item

aspects.label: Use
aspects.rule: applies to items with an active component (food, tool, weapon, equippable...) or code of their own; present if player/item/entity code names the item, a tag it is in or its id parts, or names every active component it has

aspects.label: How it is obtained
aspects.rule: applies when a recipe result, loot table entry or villager trade gives the item; present if the port loads that kind of data

aspects.label: Model and animation
aspects.rule: the entity renderer (McRender) names the entity, a tag it is in or its id parts

aspects.label: AI or behaviour
aspects.rule: entity code (McEntity, the server's entity host) names the entity, a tag it is in or its id parts

aspects.label: Drops
aspects.rule: applies when loot_table/entities/<id>.json exists; present if loot tables load and the entity's AI is present

aspects.label: Sounds
aspects.rule: applies when the sound registry has entity.<id>.* events; present if the mob sound table (McSound.cpp) lists it or audio code names it

aspects.label: Spawning
aspects.rule: applies to entities in a biome's natural spawns or a structure's spawn overrides; present if the port reads natural_mob_spawns and the entity's AI is present, or spawning code names it

categories.label: Commands

aspects.label: Syntax branches
aspects.rule: each executable path of the command in commands.json is one check; present if the command and every literal word on the path are named in McCommands; verified if a passing test runs a command line with those words in order

notes: the missing list holds commands with no branch present
